title: RFID Hose Tag — Inspection & Test-Record UHF
summary: RFID hose tags bind the full NAHAD STAMPED record to each hose assembly on a GS1 GIAI-96 identifier readable at 1-2 m. The cadence engine auto-schedules EN ISO 1402 hydrostatic tests, EN 12115 chemical-hose retests and NFPA 1962 annual fire-hose service tests, escalating overdue assemblies. Wrap-around polyurethane housings on 316L band clamps fit 25-150 mm hose ODs, rated IP68 and -40 °C to +150 °C.
heroPoints: NAHAD STAMPED record on tap — Size, Temperature, Application, Media, Pressure, Ends, Delivery per NAHAD Industrial / Hydraulic / Composite Hose Assembly Guidelines — anchored to a per-assembly GS1 GIAI-96 identifier that survives crimp, coil, drag and reel handling.

Pressure-test cadence enforced — EN ISO 1402 hydrostatic-test intervals for rubber / plastic hose, ISO 18752 / SAE J517 hydraulic-hose service, EN 12115 chemical-hose annual electrical-continuity + pressure test, EN 13766 cryogenic LNG / LPG transfer hose test, NFPA 1962 annual fire-hose service test — auto-scheduled per assembly with overdue escalation and digital inspector-presence record.

Rugged wrap-around construction — flexible polyurethane / silicone housing on 316L stainless band clamp or crimped ferrule; 25-150 mm hose OD; IP68; UV qualified ISO 4892-2 Method A 2,500 h; -40 °C to +150 °C; survives drag on pavement, coiling on reel, salt spray (ASTM B117 1,000 h) and NACE MR0175 sour service where the hose feeds a wellhead manifold.

brief.label: Chip options
brief.text: {chip:impinj-monza-r6-p:name} (96-bit EPC + 32-bit TID + 64-bit user + 32-bit tamper flag) for industrial / hydraulic / chemical hose fleets; {chip:impinj-m750:name} / M775 for long-range reel / rack inventory; {chip:nxp-ucode-9:name} / 9xe (EPC + extended user memory) for assemblies carrying last hydrostatic-test and electrical-continuity record on the tag; {chip:alien-higgs-9:name} for fire-service apparatus bay scanning. NTAG424 DNA (HF 13.56 MHz) with SUN CMAC AES-128 per-tap signature for breathing-air SCBA hose assemblies under NFPA 1852 / OSHA 29 CFR 1910.134 and for API 7K / API 16C drilling / well-control flexible lines where per-tap tamper-evidence is required.

brief.label: Frequency / air interface
brief.text: 860-960 MHz UHF Gen2v2 per EPCglobal Class 1 Gen 2 v2.1 + ISO/IEC 18000-63:2015 for apparatus-bay / rack / reel inventory; 13.56 MHz HF per ISO/IEC 14443 + NFC Forum Type 4 for per-assembly NFC-tap inspection. Tag carries both on dual-inlay SKUs. ATEX / IECEx Zone 1 / 2 reader stack for refinery, chemical plant, offshore and coal-mine hose programmes.

brief.label: Asset identifier scheme
brief.text: GS1 GIAI-96 per GS1 Tag Data Standard 2.0 §7.1 carrying NAHAD STAMPED vector (Size / Temperature / Application / Media / Pressure / Ends / Delivery), hose class (industrial / hydraulic / chemical / food-grade / composite / cryogenic / breathing-air / fire-service / drilling), layline marking reproduced from EN ISO 1402 §7 / EN 12115 §11 / EN 13766 / ISO 18752 §8 / SAE J517 §4 / NFPA 1962 §4 and vendor part-number. Inspection events published as EPCIS 2.0 ObjectEvents with bizStep=inspecting / testing / retiring and disposition=in_service / under_test / retired / damaged.

brief.label: Form-factor SKUs (6)
brief.text: (1) Wrap-around near-coupling: 75 × 25 mm polyurethane flexible tag on 316L band clamp, 25-150 mm hose OD; (2) Crimp-ferrule-embedded: 15 × 10 mm inlay swaged inside the ferrule during crimping per EN 14420 / SAE J1453 for hydraulic and chemical assemblies; (3) Coupling-body disc: 30 mm on-metal disc attached to the coupling for fire-service and API 7K drilling hoses where the coupling itself is the durable feature; (4) Reel-end header: 80 × 30 mm on-fire-apparatus reel header carrying the whole-reel identifier for NFPA 1962 fire-service deployments; (5) Food-grade sanitary: 40 × 15 mm PEEK tag USP Class VI / FDA 21 CFR §177.2600 compliant for dairy / brewing / pharmaceutical CIP/SIP assemblies; (6) Subsea / offshore ship-to-shore: 60 mm PPS + 316L overlay for EN 13766 LPG / LNG transfer and marine-loading hoses under OCIMF / SIGTTO guidance.

brief.label: Housing material & media qualification
brief.text: Polyurethane and silicone for industrial / hydraulic; PEEK with USP Class VI + FDA 21 CFR §177.2600 + EC 1935/2004 + EU 10/2011 food-contact for sanitary; PPS + 316L overlay for subsea / marine. Media compatibility per EN 12115 Annex B chemical-hose media table and NAHAD Chemical Compatibility Guide. Flame-resistance UL 94 V-0 where a hose feeds a fuel-transfer or hot-oil loop. Qualified to NACE MR0175 / ISO 15156 for wellhead manifold hoses. Cryogenic EN 13766 Annex B thermal-cycle qualification for LNG service. Electrical continuity M / Ω-M / Ω retention verified per EN 12115 §5.4 on chemical assemblies.

brief.label: Environmental & hazardous-area rating
brief.text: IP68 to IEC 60529; ATEX II 1 G / II 1 D, IECEx Zone 0 / 1 / 20 / 21 (tag passive); intrinsically safe handheld reader stack certified ATEX / IECEx Zone 1, UL / CSA Class I Div 1 Group A-D. UV qualification ISO 4892-2 Method A 2,500 h + ASTM G154 Cycle 1 2,000 h. Salt-fog ASTM B117 1,000 h for fire-service marine apparatus and offshore hose programmes. Abrasion / drag qualification per NAHAD Hose Assembly Guidelines §9 and EN ISO 1402 §6.4.

brief.text: 1-2 m UHF handheld at reel / rack / apparatus bay; up to 5 m fixed portal at the apparatus-bay door, the hose-tower test rack or the rental-yard gate for hands-free batch inventory. sections.title: Why paper tag / layline-marker hose tracking fails NAHAD STAMPED and NFPA 1962 audit
bullets: NAHAD Hose Assembly Guidelines require a STAMPED record (Size / Temperature / Application / Media / Pressure / Ends / Delivery) on each assembly. Paper hang tags and printed layline markers per EN ISO 1402 §7 / EN 12115 §11 abrade off in weeks of field service and cannot survive crimp, coil or drag.

EN ISO 1402:2021 hydrostatic-test cadence, EN 12115 annual chemical-hose hydrostatic + electrical-continuity test, EN 13766 cryogenic LPG / LNG test and NFPA 1962:2023 annual fire-hose service test cannot be defended without a per-assembly record. Paper log-book exposure is the single largest class of hose-assembly audit finding.

Fire departments run 500-2,000 hose sections plus SCBA high-pressure lines under NFPA 1962 + NFPA 1852. Insurance-carrier and AHJ audits increasingly require an electronic test record with inspector-presence evidence. Paper stamp-tag programmes no longer clear the bar.

Industrial facilities operate hundreds of hydraulic (ISO 18752 / SAE J517), chemical (EN 12115) and refinery (API 570) hoses. OSHA 29 CFR 1910.106 / 1910.120 and insurance-carrier audits cite missing or illegible inspection records as a persistent finding. The $50 hose failure that generates $500k of cleanup / lost-production exposure traces to the missing record.

Rental hose companies (Pirtek, Rapid-Sleeve, Parker Hose Doctors) managing 5,000-50,000 assemblies across customer sites need per-assembly location / utilization / inspection status. Visual counting loses inventory and stranded billable hours.

SKU + chip selection driven by hose class (industrial / hydraulic / chemical / cryogenic / breathing-air / fire / drilling) and mounting surface (wrap-around near coupling vs crimp-ferrule-embedded vs coupling-disc vs reel-header vs sanitary-PEEK vs subsea-overlay). ATEX / IECEx zone classification finalised for refinery / offshore / coal mine.

Pilot fleet: one fire station hose tower, one plant hose-rack or one rental branch runs the full EN ISO 1402 / EN 12115 / NFPA 1962 / NFPA 1852 / ISO 18752 / SAE J517 cadence under the digital programme. The pilot runs for 90 days in parallel with the paper programme. AHJ / insurance-carrier audit rehearsal validates the per-assembly export.

faq.question: How does the tag preserve the NAHAD STAMPED record through field service?
faq.answer: The full STAMPED vector rides in the tag's GS1 GIAI-96 user-memory extension, so field abrasion cannot erase it. That record covers Size, Temperature, Application, Media, Pressure, Ends, Delivery — together with the layline record required by EN ISO 1402 §7 / EN 12115 §11 / EN 13766 / ISO 18752 §8 / SAE J517 §4 / NFPA 1962 §4. The wrap-around polyurethane / silicone housing on a 316L stainless band clamp, the crimp-ferrule-embedded inlay and the coupling-disc SKU all survive coil, drag, reel handling and the ASTM B117 1,000 h salt-fog and ISO 4892-2 Method A 2,500 h UV exposure fire-service and offshore decks impose.

faq.question: Which test cadences does the platform automate?
faq.answer: The platform automates eight cadences, from EN ISO 1402 hydrostatic to API 7K / 16C well-service retest. In detail: EN ISO 1402:2021 hydrostatic-test cadence for rubber / plastic hose; EN 12115:2011 annual chemical-hose hydrostatic + §5.4 electrical-continuity retest; EN 13766:2010 cryogenic LPG / LNG ship-to-shore transfer hose test; ISO 18752:2022 hydraulic-hose tier 100k / 200k / 500k / 1M-cycle service tracking; SAE J517 hydraulic class retest; NFPA 1962:2023 §4.3 annual fire-hose service test; NFPA 1852 SCBA high-pressure hose care cadence; API Spec 7K / API Spec 16C drilling + well-service flexible-line retest. All overdue status escalates to the captain / plant AHJ / fleet manager.

faq.question: Does the programme satisfy USCG marine-transfer and OCIMF survey?
faq.answer: Yes. The subsea / marine SKU (PPS + 316L overlay) plus the NTAG424 DNA SUN CMAC AES-128 per-tap signature produces an evidentiary-grade per-hose record aligned to USCG 33 CFR 156 (transfer of oil and hazardous materials in bulk), OCIMF Guidelines for the Handling, Storage, Inspection and Testing of Hoses in the Marine Environment, DNV / ABS marine-transfer hose approvals and EN 13766 cryogenic LPG / LNG test. Coast-Guard and class-society audits resolve the per-assembly test history in seconds.

faq.question: Can the same programme cover sanitary food / pharma hoses and GMP CIP/SIP assemblies?
faq.answer: Yes. The food-grade sanitary SKU uses a PEEK housing qualified to USP Class VI, ISO 10993-5, FDA 21 CFR §177.2600 and EC 1935/2004 + EU 10/2011 food-contact plastics. Paired with an NTAG424 DNA SUN CMAC AES-128 per-tap signature the assembly record is acceptable under FDA 21 CFR Part 11 / EU EMA Annex 11 electronic-records expectations for GMP. CIP/SIP cycle history is captured against the same GIAI-96.
